title: Crimson Forest - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Crimson Forest in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A red-tinted forest whose final boss drops Chevalam. It also holds a Paint Cage containing Nusaro.

sections.title: Bosses Here
sections.content: Chromatic Gold Chevaliere, Crimson Forest final boss
